Hmm, but maybe DOWN moves the black piece, and the black is blocked? The black is at rows 18-29, cols 45-59. DOWN should move the black to rows 24-35 — there's nothing there. The black didn't move either. So in level 2, DOWN does nothing to either piece?? That's strange.
